test.query: SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000000) WHERE materialize(identity(now())) > toString(toDateTime('2020-09-30 00:00:00'))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000000) WHERE materialize(identity(now())) > toUInt32(toDateTime('2020-09-30 00:00:00'))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000000) WHERE materialize(identity(now())) > toDateTime('2020-09-30 00:00:00')
SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000000) WHERE materialize(identity(now())) > toDate('2020-09-30 00:00:00')

SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000000) WHERE materialize(identity(toDateTime(1000000))) = toDateTime(1000000)
